s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of cognitive decline with disorganized speech, anxiety, and self-harm behaviors, progressing to agitation, delusions, hallucinations, and incontinence
salient_findings: Abrupt onset of disorganized speech and self-harm behaviors
Development of agitation, persecutory delusions, and hallucinations
key_facts: 74-year-old right-handed woman
5-month history of symptoms
Symptoms began after a family trip
Disorganized speech, severe anxiety, and self-harm behaviors
Rapid, fluent, and nonsensical speech
Agitation, persecutory delusions, visual and auditory hallucinations
Urinary and fecal incontinence
Persistent urge to flee her home
10-year history of depression treated with sertraline
No prior cognitive impairment or neurological disease
Disoriented to time
Anomia and perseveration on the Clock Drawing Test
Impaired performance on Luria’s three-step test
Defective crossed-pentagon drawing
MMSE score of 2/30 and an ACE-R score of 2/100

shortlist.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
shortlist.why_kept: rapid progression of cognitive decline and neurological symptoms

shortlist.label: Hashimoto's encephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: acute onset of cognitive decline and psychiatric symptoms

shortlist.label: Herpes simplex encephalitis

raw.rationale: The patient's rapid onset of symptoms, including disorganized speech, severe anxiety, self-harm behaviors, and rapid decline in cognitive function, are consistent with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, a rare neurodegenerative disorder caused by prions.

rejected.label: Hashimoto's encephalopathy
rejected.why: Typically presents with a more gradual onset of symptoms and is often associated with autoimmune thyroiditis

rejected.label: Herpes simplex encephalitis
rejected.why: Usually presents with fever, headache, and seizures, which are not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Limbic encephalitis
rejected.why: Typically presents with memory loss, seizures, and changes in behavior, but the patient's symptoms are more widespread and include disorganized speech and self-harm behaviors

rejected.label: Prion disease
rejected.why: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease is a type of prion disease, so this option is not distinct from the champion
